diagnostics.title: Zod 3 schema API breaks in Zod 4
diagnostics.message: This Zod 3 schema API changed in Zod 4, so this schema can fail after the upgrade.
diagnostics.help: Switch to the Zod 4 versions: top-level factories like `z.enum()`, object helpers like `z.strictObject()`, the new `z.function({ input, output })` form, and explicit key/value schemas for `z.record()`.

diagnostics.title: Format method on z.string()
diagnostics.message: This `z.string().<format>()` check is deprecated in Zod 4, so it can break during the upgrade.
diagnostics.help: Use the Zod 4 top-level format checks like `z.email()`, `z.uuid()`, or `z.ipv4()` instead of `z.string().<format>()`.

diagnostics.title: Custom modal instead of dialog
diagnostics.message: Keyboard users can tab out of this `role="dialog"` modal because it has no built-in focus trapping, so use the native `<dialog>`, which gives you focus trapping, `Escape` to close, and the backdrop for free.
diagnostics.help: Replace the wrapper with `<dialog>` and open it with `dialog.showModal()`. For the trigger, prefer `<button commandfor="id" command="show-modal">` (Chrome 135+), or a `useRef` with `dialogRef.current?.showModal()`.
